stemMd: What happened on the new classification test?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The rereading group necessarily outperformed every retrieval participant.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The retrieval group retained a smaller average advantage.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The test was cancelled because symbols were unfamiliar.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Both groups obtained identical mean scores.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Only the original prompt format was used.

explanationMd: The second test reduces but does not eliminate the group difference, providing some evidence beyond the original response format.

distractorRationale.a: No such universal reversal is reported.
distractorRationale.e: The new task required a different classification use.
